propositions: A live Gerrit probe with four sequential patchsets must validate that the deployed review bot correctly loads and executes the project.review-phase-boundaries criterion through the full four-pass pipeline without blocking contributors.

The positive-control patchset (PS1) establishes baseline execution: the criterion must remain absent from all verdict buckets (blocking, advisory, dropped, indeterminate) when the Pass-1 discovery refinement is reviewed, proving no spurious findings.

The historical severity-only patchset (PS2) documents stimulus limitation: the criterion must abstain because the test sentence assigns action without naming instructed/owning phases, establishing what the criterion requires to activate.

The predeclared RP-F2 FIRE-control patchset (PS3) must produce a project-attributed advisory finding with reviewer_id=code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries, criteria=[project.review-phase-boundaries], Pass-2 validity/impact observations, and Pass-3 decision=advisory with block_threshold=0.90 and blocking_enabled=false.
The cleaned final patchset (PS4) must contain only valid phase-compliant instructions, produce no project-criterion finding, and be the sole revision submitted to main.
Blocking must remain disabled throughout the probe; blocking promotion is deferred to a separate future ticket backed by production evidence.
